# Scholarships & Study Abroad Hub
> Verified directory and real-time knowledge base of online communities for international education, Erasmus Mundus, Chevening, Fulbright, DAAD scholarships, and university admissions.

## Key Navigation
- [Scholarships & Study Abroad Hub Directory Index](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/scholarships-study-abroad-hub/): Searchable, filterable database of verified communities across Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, and Reddit.
- [About & Curation Standards](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/scholarships-study-abroad-hub/about.html): Vetting methodology, anti-spam filters, and quality benchmarks.
- [Submit a Community](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/scholarships-study-abroad-hub/submit.html): Public submission portal for community admins and creators.
- [Contact & DMCA Removal](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/scholarships-study-abroad-hub/contact.html): Direct operator inquiries, takedown requests, and partnerships.
- [Privacy Policy](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/scholarships-study-abroad-hub/privacy.html): GDPR & CCPA privacy compliance disclosures.
- [Terms of Service](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/scholarships-study-abroad-hub/terms.html): User agreement, third-party platform disclaimers, and liability terms.
- [XML Sitemap](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/scholarships-study-abroad-hub/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable URL index and crawling priority directives.
- [RSS Syndication Feed](https://jibranpcccc.github.io/scholarships-study-abroad-hub/feed.xml): Real-time syndication feed for newly discovered groups and platform updates.

## Coverage
- Discord Servers: Real-time discussions, voice channels, events, and sub-groups.
- Telegram Channels & Groups: Instant alerts, alpha calls, announcements, and peer chats.
- WhatsApp Groups: Focused cohorts and regional professional networks.
- Reddit Subreddits: Community threads, wiki guides, and discussions.

## Quality & Verification
All listed channels undergo authentication checks, link liveness verification, and member activity monitoring.
